name: CoFly-WeedDB: UAV Cotton Field Weed Detection and Segmentation Dataset
description: CoFly-WeedDB is an open-access unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) image dataset captured for weed detection, species identification, and semantic segmentation in row-crop cotton farming, published on Zenodo by researchers at the Agricultural University of Athens and CERTH. Captured using a DJI Phantom 4 Pro at an altitude of 5 meters over cotton fields in Larissa, Greece, the dataset contains 366 high-resolution RGB images (201 densely annotated with pixel-level segmentation masks) covering three target weed species: Johnson grass, Field bindweed, and Purslane.
